section.title: Activity
section.para: Noah has 50 meters of fencing to completely enclose a rectangular garden in the backyard.

list.item: Draw some possible diagrams of Noah’s garden. Label the length and width of each rectangle.

problem.para: Write down your answer, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: Your answers will vary. Did you consider organizing your lengths, widths, and areas into a table? For example:

div.para: When the length and width are each 12.5 meters, the area is the largest (156.25 square meters). A table shows that as the rectangular shape gets closer and closer to being a square, the area gets larger.

list.item: Find the length and width of a rectangle that would produce the largest possible area. Explain why you think that pair of length and width gives the largest possible area.
